Never forward raw message/detail text. Preserve bounded retry ownership in one layer; do not automatically retry malformed schemas.

recommendations: Keep live runtime follow-up evidence separate from shipping feature session behavior: current CodexProvider closes its session after final answer, so multi-feature follow-up requires a deliberate canonical-context/session contract and must not be claimed enabled merely from runtime capability.

Cancellation probes prove local process/connection rejection only. They do not establish upstream billing cancellation, server-side release latency, or absence of every late event across a deployed native job.

429 handling here is synthetic fault injection, not a real throttled LB response; do not intentionally exhaust quota to manufacture one. Record true live 429 gate unverified until safely observed or authorized service-side fault injection exists.

The deadline probe uses explicit abort after 50ms of active work. The provider deadline path was separately injected against an unresponsive synthetic connection; real inference timeout over its full shipping deadline remains unverified.
